description: The broad extraction an Android adb backup would need: every app's data parsed into a searchable form. Declared so that the preparation of an adb backup is on the record as declined, with why, rather than missing.
exclusions: every app's data: nothing is parsed (see unavailable)
unavailable: no program in the mobile job image parses an adb backup's app tree (apps/<package>/db, f, sp, r) as a whole: ALEAPP reads a file-system layout (data/data/<package>/databases), and nothing in the image converts one into the other. The android-backup recipe lists every member; read the databases it lists with sqlite3 and the pack's tools
covers: Nothing: it is declared, never run. Its detect step reads the backup's header only.
